description: This file describes the concept of subsystems within the Thunder framework, including how they are managed, their metadata, interfaces, how plugins can interact with them (activate, deactivate, query status), and how subsystem dependencies are configured via plugin metadata. It explains the subsystems supported, their interfaces, notification mechanisms, and plugin lifecycle management considerations related to subsystems.

classes.name: InternetInfo
classes.description: Implementation of the IInternet interface to provide internet subsystem metadata such as public IP address and network type.

methods.name: InternetInfo::PublicIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the current public IP address of the device as known by this implementation.

methods.name: InternetInfo::NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (IPv4, IPv6, or Unknown) of the internet connection.
